description: This PHP class 'FencedCodeRenderer' is part of a markdown rendering tool tailored for Confluence content within a documentation generation system. It handles rendering fenced code blocks with support for custom languages and special types like 'tex' and 'mermaid'.

classes.name: FencedCodeRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for fenced code blocks in markdown, supporting various languages and special types like 'tex' and 'mermaid'. It extends 'CodeRenderer' and interacts with configuration and external markdown node structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with a 'Config' object for configuration settings.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a markdown fenced code block node into an HTML element, handling special languages and setting config flags for 'tex' and 'mermaid' types.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Determines the language of the fenced code block, normalizes aliases, and verifies support; returns false if unsupported or unspecified.
